create_pendulum_swingup_env: create a pendulum swingup environment with default configuration for reinforcement learning
run_pendulum_swingup_reset: run the pendulum swingup environment reset with a JAX random number generator
run_pendulum_swingup_step: run the pendulum swingup environment step with state and action arrays
get_pendulum_observation: get the pendulum observation from simulation data including pole orientation and angular velocity
get_pendulum_reward: get the pendulum reward using tolerance-based scoring for pole vertical position
